Both σεισμός and μέγας are anarthrous and the ASV supplies one determiner for the phrase, so under rule 58 the determiner belongs to the noun and the adjective stands bare; the unit is discontinuous under rule 15, as rule 58's ὥραν … ἑβδόμην → at the seventh hour is. Rule 51's anarthrous clause points the same way, a determiner determining the noun phrase rather than the modifier inside it. This replaces a reading that gave a great to μέγας, which is the failure rule 58 names in terms — reading a supplied determiner off English word order because it stands next to the adjective.
